title: How long can a two-cycle quantum conveyor operate?
intro: Main line: the chain of objects from the model to the measured quantity (Appendix A of the solutions). Left, amber: open links that a calculation with existing theory would close (O-calc). Right, red: open links where the closest existing theory needs a hypothesis that fails here (O-theory). Tick a link when a result closes it.
emptyNote: No open link at this step.

start.title: The model
start.text: H_MFP(t), the interacting driven chain of paper [1] (S: stated in a source).

end.title: Research target
end.text: Predict when the original interacting pump leaves a chosen charge tolerance, and identify the process that controls that change.

following-one-flavor.name: The particles keep following one flavor
following-one-flavor.note: a gap above the two flavor configurations, uniform in system size and over the cycle; the composite gap protects only the plane, not the direction in it
following-one-flavor.ref: many-body adiabatic theorem; many-body Chern number (Niu-Thouless-Wu)

dressing-assembled.name: Local dressing assembled along the chain and the cycle
dressing-assembled.note: build the corrections at every phase, join them smoothly, bound the overlap terms

kept-dynamics.name: The kept dynamics K_ret
kept-dynamics.note: a spectral gap uniform in system size
kept-dynamics.ref: quasi-adiabatic continuation (Hastings); adiabatic theorems for extended systems (Bachmann-De Roeck-Fraas; Monaco-Teufel)

local-state-full-drive.name: The local state over the full drive
local-state-full-drive.note: the bounds grow with time; the boundary correlations do not close at the times of interest

certificate-inputs.name: The certificate inputs α, I₀, η, δ₀, t_max
certificate-inputs.note: evaluate them in one frame for one initial state, once the local state is controlled

first-failure.name: The first failed window
first-failure.note: a fast drive or a large gap; here the drive is slow

footer: Shared gap of the O-theory links: no existing theory controls a slowly driven, strongly correlated chain over long times when its order is not protected by a uniform gap. A first controlled result is a limit in which the failing hypothesis holds, for example a gap that protects the whole group of flavor configurations rather than one of them.

Labels on the main line: S stated in a source; D derived in the booklet; D/O-calc and D/O-theory: the identity is derived, and its inputs for the real system are open, of that kind. The label says whether a method exists, not how much work remains.
